description: This file implements the OcdmSession class, which manages DRM sessions using the OpenCDM API. It includes methods for constructing, loading, updating, decrypting, and managing DRM sessions, as well as handling callbacks for key updates and errors.

classes.name: OcdmSession
classes.description: A class managing DRM sessions, including creation, challenge handling, license management, decryption, and callback handling.

methods.name: constructSession
methods.description: Creates a new DRM session with specified session type and init data.

methods.name: getChallengeData
methods.description: Retrieves challenge data for license acquisition.

methods.name: storeLicenseData
methods.description: Stores license data received from license server.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the session with license response data.

methods.name: decryptBuffer
methods.description: Decrypts an encrypted buffer using the session.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Performs decryption with optional sub-sample, IV, and key ID buffers.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a key within the session.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Gets the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Selects a specific key ID for the session.

methods.name: hasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a key ID exists in the session.

methods.name: setDrmHeader
methods.description: Sets the DRM header for the session.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Retrieves the last DRM error code.
